## Summary

Describe the change and the semantic/reproducibility problem it addresses.

## Validation

- [ ] `pytest -q` passes
- [ ] New behavior has tests or a reproducible example
- [ ] Runtime/source versions and hashes are recorded when applicable
- [ ] No model weights, private datasets, credentials, or local absolute paths are committed
- [ ] Numerical tolerance / aggregation / fail-closed behavior is unchanged, or the change is explicitly justified

## Claim boundary

State whether this changes any result, claim, certificate boundary, or supported runtime profile.
